qs.stem: If the sum of the first n terms of a sequence is S<sub>n</sub> = 5n<sup>2</sup> + 4n, the 7<sup>th</sup> term is
qs.trap: Taking T<sub>k</sub> = S<sub>k</sub>.

qs.stem: The area (in square units) of the region bounded by y = x<sup>2</sup> and y = 12x is
steps: The curves meet at x = 0 and x = 12.
qs.trap: Forgetting to subtract the area under the parabola.

qs.stem: If α and β are the roots of x<sup>2</sup> − 12x + 32 = 0, then α<sup>2</sup> + β<sup>2</sup> is equal to
qs.trap: Using +2αβ instead of −2αβ.

qs.stem: The distance of the point (-5, -5) from the line 6x + 8y + 110 = 0 is
qs.trap: Forgetting to divide by √(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>).

qs.stem: For the vectors a = −1i +2j +0k and b = −2i +1j +0k, |a × b|<sup>2</sup> equals
qs.trap: Using + (a·b)<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: The number of distinct arrangements of all the letters of the word INDIA is
steps: The word has 5 letters. Repeated letters: I×2.
qs.trap: Not dividing by the factorial of each repeated letter.

qs.stem: If f(x) = 2x<sup>3</sup> + 2x<sup>2</sup> + 2x, then f′(1) equals
qs.trap: Evaluating f instead of f′.

qs.stem: Two fair dice are thrown. The probability that the sum is 9 given that at least one die shows 4 is
steps: Outcomes with at least one 4: 11 (out of 36).
Of these, the sum is 9 in 2 cases.
qs.trap: Dividing by 36 instead of by the reduced sample space.

qs.stem: If tan A = 1/2 and tan B = 1/2, then tan(A + B) is
steps: tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B)/(1 − tan A tan B).
qs.trap: Using + in the denominator.

qs.stem: If A = [[1, 3], [0, 1]], the sum of all the entries of A<sup>9</sup> is
steps: A<sup>9</sup> = [[1, 27], [0, 1]], whose entries add up to 2 + 27 = 29.
qs.trap: Computing A<sup>p</sup> as entrywise powers.

qs.stem: The number of one-one functions from a set with 3 elements to a set with 6 elements is
steps: The first element has 6 images, the next 5, and so on.
qs.trap: Using n<sup>m</sup> (all functions, not only one-one).

qs.stem: If dy/dx = 4y with y(0) = 3, then y(ln 3 / 4) equals
steps: At x = ln 3/4: e<sup>ln 3</sup> = 3, so y = 3 × 3 = 9.
qs.trap: Evaluating e<sup>kx</sup> as x instead of e<sup>ln m</sup> = m.

qs.stem: For z<sub>1</sub> = 1 + 4i and z<sub>2</sub> = 1 + 6i, the value of |z<sub>1</sub>z<sub>2</sub>|<sup>2</sup> is
qs.trap: Adding the squared moduli instead of multiplying.

qs.stem: The sum of the order and the degree of the differential equation (d<sup>2</sup>y/dx<sup>2</sup>)<sup>2</sup> + (dy/dx)<sup>4</sup> = x is
steps: Degree = power of that highest derivative once the equation is a polynomial in derivatives = 2.
qs.trap: Taking the largest power anywhere as the degree.

qs.stem: For a binomial distribution the mean is 40 and the variance is 40/3. The number of trials n is
steps: Mean = np and variance = npq, so q = variance/mean = 1/3 and p = 2/3.
qs.trap: Taking n = mean or n = mean + variance.

qs.stem: lim<sub>x→0</sub> sin(5x)/(4x) equals
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 5 terms of the geometric progression 2, 4, 8, … is
qs.trap: Using r<sup>n+1</sup> instead of r<sup>n</sup>.

qs.stem: A committee of 4 is chosen from 4 men and 6 women. The number of committees containing at least one woman is
qs.trap: Counting a committee with two women twice (choose one woman, then anyone).

qs.stem: The determinant of the matrix with rows [3 −2 2]   [1 1 −3]   [0 3 1] is
steps: Expand along the first row: a(ei − fh) − b(di − fg) + c(dh − eg).
qs.trap: Sign slip on the middle term of the expansion.

qs.stem: The distance between the foci of the ellipse x<sup>2</sup>/625 + y<sup>2</sup>/49 = 1 is
steps: a<sup>2</sup> = 625, b<sup>2</sup> = 49 so c<sup>2</sup> = a<sup>2</sup> − b<sup>2</sup> = 576, c = 24.
qs.trap: Giving c instead of 2c.

qs.stem: The number of solutions of sin 2x = 0 in the interval [0, 2π] is
steps: Write the general solution and count the values of x that fall in [0, 2π], including both end points.
qs.trap: Missing an end point of the closed interval.

qs.stem: The maximum value of f(x) = −3x<sup>2</sup> + 6x + 7 is
steps: The maximum occurs at x = 1 and equals 10.
qs.trap: Reading the constant term 7 as the maximum.

qs.stem: The number of ways of distributing 8 identical balls into 5 different boxes (a box may stay empty) is
steps: Number of non-negative solutions of x<sub>1</sub> + … + x<sub>5</sub> = 8 is C(8 + 5 − 1, 5 − 1).
qs.trap: Using 5<sup>8</sup> (that is for different balls).

qs.stem: The radius of the circle x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> − 6x − 4y + 4 = 0 is
steps: Compare with x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0: g = −3, f = −2, c = 4.
qs.trap: Reporting r<sup>2</sup> instead of r.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 15 terms of the arithmetic progression 2, 8, 14, … is
qs.trap: Using nd instead of (n − 1)d.

qs.stem: Two capacitors of 4 μF and 4 μF are connected in parallel. The equivalent capacitance is (in μF)
qs.trap: Mixing up the series and parallel formulas.

qs.stem: The dimensional formula of (energy × area) is
qs.trap: Adding exponents when dividing.

qs.stem: A rotating platform has moment of inertia 8 kg m<sup>2</sup> and angular speed 15 rad/s. A person on it changes the moment of inertia to 10 kg m<sup>2</sup> without any external torque. The new angular speed is (in rad/s)
steps: Angular momentum is conserved: I<sub>1</sub>ω<sub>1</sub> = I<sub>2</sub>ω<sub>2</sub>.
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio of the moments of inertia.

qs.stem: An ideal transformer has 100 turns in the primary and 400 in the secondary. The primary current is 10 A. The secondary current is (in A)
steps: Ideal transformer: V<sub>p</sub>I<sub>p</sub> = V<sub>s</sub>I<sub>s</sub>, so I<sub>s</sub>/I<sub>p</sub> = N<sub>p</sub>/N<sub>s</sub>.
qs.trap: Using the voltage ratio for currents.

qs.stem: A body is projected with speed 20 m/s at an angle whose sine is 0.5. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the maximum height reached is (in m)
qs.trap: Using the full speed instead of the vertical component.

qs.stem: A spring of force constant 100 N/m is compressed by 0.3 m. The energy stored in it is (in J)
qs.trap: Forgetting the ½, or not squaring x.

qs.stem: A body weighs 450 N on the surface of the earth (radius R). Its weight at a height of 2R above the surface is (in N)
steps: g′ = g R<sup>2</sup>/(R + h)<sup>2</sup> = g/(1 + h/R)<sup>2</sup> = g/9.
qs.trap: Dividing by (R + h) instead of (R + h)<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: A block slides down a rough incline of angle 37° (sin 37° = 0.6, cos 37° = 0.8) with coefficient of friction 0.125. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, its acceleration is (in m/s<sup>2</sup>)
qs.trap: Swapping sinθ and cosθ.

qs.stem: Two point charges of 5 μC and 6 μC are placed 3 cm apart in air (1/4πε<sub>0</sub> = 9 × 10<sup>9</sup> N m<sup>2</sup>/C<sup>2</sup>). The force between them is (in N)
qs.trap: Converting cm to m incorrectly.

qs.stem: A heater of resistance 6 Ω is connected to a 12 V supply for 60 s. The heat produced is (in J)
qs.trap: Using I = V/R as the power.

qs.stem: A wave of frequency 50 Hz has wavelength 6 m. Its speed is (in m/s)
qs.trap: Dividing instead of multiplying.

qs.stem: An object is placed 15 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 10 cm. The image is formed at a distance (in cm) of
qs.trap: Using u as a positive number in the lens formula.

qs.stem: A fixed mass of ideal gas goes from (P = 4 atm, V = 2 L, T = 150 K) to a state with P = 2 atm and V = 6 L. The final temperature is (in K)
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio.

qs.stem: In measuring kinetic energy K = ½mv<sup>2</sup>, the mass has a 4% error and the speed a 2% error. The maximum percentage error in K is
qs.trap: Not doubling the speed error for v<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: The moment of inertia of a uniform disc of mass 12 kg and radius 0.5 m about an axis through its centre (perpendicular to the plane for the disc and ring) is (in kg m<sup>2</sup>)
steps: I = 0.5 MR<sup>2</sup> for a uniform disc.
qs.trap: Using the wrong numerical factor for the shape.

qs.stem: A Carnot engine works between a source at 500 K and a sink at 400 K. Its efficiency (in %) is
qs.trap: Using T<sub>2</sub>/T<sub>1</sub> as the efficiency.

qs.stem: Light of wavelength 413 nm falls on a metal of work function 2 eV (hc = 1240 eV nm). The maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons is (in eV)
qs.trap: Giving the photon energy instead of the kinetic energy.

qs.stem: Two capacitors of 4 μF and 12 μF are connected in parallel. The equivalent capacitance is (in μF)
qs.trap: Mixing up the series and parallel formulas.

qs.stem: A straight wire of length 0.5 m carrying 10 A is placed in a uniform magnetic field of 0.2 T at 30° to the field. The force on the wire is (in N)
qs.trap: Leaving out sinθ (or using cosθ).

qs.stem: Two masses 4 kg and 2 kg hang from a light string over a smooth pulley (Atwood machine). Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the tension in the string is (in N)
qs.trap: Taking the tension equal to the weight of the heavier mass.

qs.stem: In Young's double-slit experiment the slit separation is 0.25 mm, the screen is 1 m away and the wavelength is 500 nm. The fringe width is (in mm)
qs.trap: Unit slip between nm, mm and m.

qs.stem: A system absorbs 690 J of heat and does 50 J of work on its surroundings. The change in its internal energy is (in J)
qs.trap: Adding work done by the system to the heat absorbed.

qs.stem: A car moving at 50 m/s is brought to rest by a uniform retardation of 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>. The distance travelled before stopping is (in m)
qs.trap: Forgetting the factor 2 in 2as.

qs.stem: A 1 kg mass attached to a spring of constant 900 N/m oscillates with amplitude 3 cm. Its maximum speed is (in cm/s)
qs.trap: Using ω<sup>2</sup> instead of ω.

qs.stem: In measuring kinetic energy K = ½mv<sup>2</sup>, the mass has a 4% error and the speed a 4% error. The maximum percentage error in K is
qs.trap: Not doubling the speed error for v<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: The number of different tripeptides that can be formed from 3 different amino acids if each amino acid may be used any number of times is
qs.trap: Not allowing a repeated amino acid.

qs.stem: For a reaction ΔH = 50 kJ and ΔS = 100 J/K. The value of ΔG at 600 K is (in kJ)
qs.trap: Not converting J to kJ.

qs.stem: The rate law of a substitution reaction is rate = k[RX][Nu<sup>−</sup>]. If the concentrations of both RX and Nu<sup>−</sup> are multiplied by 3, the rate changes by a factor of
steps: The rate depends only on the species present in the rate law, each to its own power.
qs.trap: Counting a species that is not in the rate law.

qs.stem: The spin-only magnetic moment of [Fe(CN)<sub>6</sub>]<sup>4−</sup> is (in BM)
qs.trap: Using n instead of √[n(n + 2)].

qs.stem: The maximum number of orbitals in the shell with principal quantum number n = 2 is
steps: Each subshell l has 2l + 1 orbitals and l runs from 0 to n − 1.
qs.trap: Giving the number of electrons (2n<sup>2</sup>) instead.

qs.stem: From the reaction N<sub>2</sub> + 3H<sub>2</sub> → 2NH<sub>3</sub>, the mass of NH<sub>3</sub> formed from 56 g of nitrogen (completely reacted) is (in g)
steps: 1 mol of nitrogen gives 2 mol of NH<sub>3</sub>, so moles of NH<sub>3</sub> = 4.
qs.trap: Ignoring the mole ratio in the balanced equation.

qs.stem: The depression in freezing point of a 0.1 m aqueous solution of CaCl<sub>2</sub> (assume complete dissociation) is (K<sub>f</sub> = 1.86 K kg/mol; in K)
steps: ΔT<sub>f</sub> = i K<sub>f</sub> m with van't Hoff factor i = 3.
qs.trap: Using i = 1 for an electrolyte.

qs.stem: For N<sub>2</sub> + 3H<sub>2</sub> ⇌ 2NH<sub>3</sub> the equilibrium concentrations are [N<sub>2</sub>] = 1 M, [H<sub>2</sub>] = 1 M and [NH<sub>3</sub>] = 11 M. The value of K<sub>c</sub> is
qs.trap: Writing the ratio upside-down or ignoring the stoichiometric powers.

qs.stem: According to molecular orbital theory, the bond order of Li<sub>2</sub> is
steps: Fill the molecular orbitals in order and use bond order = (N<sub>b</sub> − N<sub>a</sub>)/2.
For Li<sub>2</sub> the bond order is 1.
qs.trap: Using the electron count of the neutral molecule for an ion.

qs.stem: The oxidation number of N in NH<sub>4</sub><sup>+</sup> is
steps: Assign O = −2 (or the usual values) and balance the total charge.
qs.trap: Forgetting the overall charge on the ion.

qs.stem: A first-order reaction has 800 g of reactant initially. After 3 half-lives the amount left is (in g)
steps: After each half-life the amount halves.
qs.trap: Dividing by the number of half-lives instead of 2 raised to it.

qs.stem: The number of moles of H<sub>2</sub> needed to hydrogenate 1 mole of buta-1,3-diene completely is
steps: Add 1 mol H<sub>2</sub> per C=C (or per ring in a saturated ring), 2 mol per C≡C, and 3 mol per benzene ring.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as taking one mole.

qs.stem: The number of structural isomers (ignoring stereoisomers) of the amine C<sub>4</sub>H<sub>11</sub>N (all amines) is
steps: Enumerate carbon skeletons, then place the functional group.
qs.trap: Missing a branched skeleton or counting stereoisomers.

qs.stem: Among Si, Cl, H, F, the element with the lowest electronegativity (Pauling scale) is
steps: Pauling values: Si 1.8, Cl 3.0, H 2.1, F 4.0.
qs.trap: Reading the trend down a group the wrong way.

qs.stem: The steric number (bond pairs + lone pairs) of the central atom in NH<sub>3</sub>, which has a pyramidal shape, is
steps: 3 bond pairs and 1 lone pairs on N.
qs.trap: Ignoring the lone pairs.

qs.stem: 100 mL of a 1 M solution is diluted until its molarity is 0.25 M. The final volume of the solution is (in mL)
qs.trap: Giving the volume of water added instead of the final volume.

qs.stem: The number of different monochloro structural isomers obtainable from n-butane by free-radical chlorination (ignore stereoisomers) is
steps: Count the sets of equivalent hydrogens: each set gives one monochloro product.
qs.trap: Counting every hydrogen as different.

qs.stem: The pH of a 10<sup>−4</sup> M aqueous HCl solution at 25°C is
steps: HCl is a strong acid: [H<sup>+</sup>] = 10<sup>−4</sup> M.
qs.trap: Confusing pH with pOH.

qs.stem: Given A → B, ΔH = −114 kJ and B → C, ΔH = −76 kJ, the enthalpy change for 3A → 3C is (in kJ)
steps: Multiplying the equation by 3 multiplies ΔH: -570 kJ.
qs.trap: Not scaling ΔH by the stoichiometric factor.

qs.stem: The mass of zinc (molar mass 65 g/mol, ion charge 2+) deposited by passing 289500 C of charge is (in g; F = 96500 C/mol)
qs.trap: Ignoring the charge on the ion.

qs.stem: The number of sigma (σ) bonds in benzene (C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>6</sub>) is
steps: Every bond has one σ bond; each double bond adds one π bond and each triple bond adds two.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as one π bond.

qs.stem: The number of moles of O<sub>2</sub> required for complete combustion of 1 mole of the hydrocarbon C<sub>7</sub>H<sub>8</sub> is
qs.trap: Using y/2 instead of y/4.

qs.stem: Liquids A and B form an ideal solution of 5 mol A and 5 mol B. Their vapour pressures when pure are 200 mm Hg and 300 mm Hg. The total vapour pressure of the solution is (in mm Hg)
qs.trap: Averaging the two pure vapour pressures without weighting by mole fraction.

qs.stem: For hydrogen-like species, the ratio of the radius of the n = 4 orbit to that of the n = 2 orbit (same species) is
qs.trap: Using r ∝ n instead of n<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: The degree of unsaturation (double-bond equivalents) of C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>12</sub> is
steps: DBE = (2C + 2 + N − H − X)/2 (oxygen does not count).
qs.trap: Counting oxygen or forgetting that N adds 1.
